svg.title: Built from scratch
svg.desc: WACC compiler (Scala 3 → x86-64): Parser-combinator frontend, typed AST, two-stage IR backend, a type checker that reports every error at once. 180+ tests pass; PintOS kernel (C): Priority scheduling with recursive donation across lock chains, a fixed-point 4.4BSD MLFQS, a 13-syscall dispatcher. 116 / 116 tests; ARMv8 toolchain (C): Two-pass assembler and fetch-decode-execute emulator for AArch64, with a sample program that drives Raspberry Pi GPIO. No deps beyond libc; Transformer, by hand (NumPy): Live-coded for AI Society lectures, building up from an MLP in PyTorch to a transformer with no framework. Taught to 150
